svg.title: Angular-bin input for the event-rate and transport-rate coding exercise
svg.desc: The incoming direction is positive x. Bin zero is forward, cos(theta0)=1, and bin one is perpendicular, cos(theta1)=0. The supplied rate weights are respectively 4 and 6 inverse seconds, already integrated over their angular bins. The bars show these inputs, not the summed outputs. The event rate sums w_i; the transport rate sums w_i[1-cos(thetai)].
svg.text: The coding input is a rate assigned to each outgoing bin
